findings.original_issue: FunnelStep.copyOf reference-copies customFieldValue:Object — no defensive copy for a loosely typed field.
findings.resolution_notes: Fix kept Object + reference copy but documented the validated-immutable-scalar contract at two layers: the field Javadoc (FunnelStep.java lines 33-40) and the copyOf Javadoc (lines 46-56). The contract states that customFieldValue is always one of Double / Boolean / Instant / String (all immutable JVM types), enforced by CustomFieldValueValidator in Task 4/5. Because the value is always an immutable scalar, a reference copy is a genuine deep copy. The architectural boundary and responsibility delegation are explicit and accurate. Resolution is acceptable.

findings.original_issue: Redundant @Indexed on Funnel.projectId — already covered by the (projectId, status) compound index prefix.
findings.resolution_notes: Standalone @Indexed removed from Funnel.projectId. An inline comment (Funnel.java lines 41-43) explains why it is absent here vs retained on FunnelExecution.projectId (where the other compound is partial, so it does not serve as a cascade lookup). Clear and correct.

findings.original_issue: FunnelStepTest.deepCopyProducesIndependentStep did not cover customFieldValue or several other fields.
findings.resolution_notes: Test now populates all 11 fields including customFieldValue, asserts field-equality after copy, then asserts independence in both directions (copy mutation and source mutation) for every field. Coverage is comprehensive. The copyOfNullIsNull guard test is also retained.

summary: All three round-1 findings are resolved. Finding 1 (major) was resolved by documentation rather than a defensive copy: the immutable-scalar contract on customFieldValue is clearly stated at both the field and the copyOf method, making a reference copy a correct deep copy. The resolution is acceptable. Findings 2 and 3 were fixed directly. No new issues were identified in the five changed files (Funnel.java, FunnelExecution.java, FunnelStep.java, FunnelIndexesIT.java, FunnelStepTest.java).
